Questions and answers

What is Sécurité du Service Mesh?

In this glossary, Sécurité du Service Mesh refers to: A set of controls, policies, and tools for ensuring secure communication, authentication, and authorization between microservices within a service mesh architecture.

How is Sécurité du Service Mesh used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Activez la sécurité du service mesh pour chiffrer le trafic entre services, appliquer le TLS mutuel et appliquer les politiques de contrôle d'accès au niveau du mesh."

Definition

A set of controls, policies, and tools for ensuring secure communication, authentication, and authorization between microservices within a service mesh architecture.

Operational example

Enable service mesh security to encrypt service-to-service traffic, enforce mutual TLS, and apply access control policies at the mesh layer.

Localized term

Sécurité du Service Mesh

Localized example

Activez la sécurité du service mesh pour chiffrer le trafic entre services, appliquer le TLS mutuel et appliquer les politiques de contrôle d'accès au niveau du mesh.
